chunks: “It is not from dignity that a man relate what he encounters during travel of good or evil.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةِ: dignity, noble character, and manly virtue in conduct
key_terms.شَرٍّ: evil or unpleasantness that one encounters
key_terms.يُحَدِّثَ: to speak about, recount, or narrate

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about recounting one's experiences during travel?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that true dignity and muru'ah include restraint in speech about one's travel experiences. A person should not make a habit of recounting every good or bad thing encountered on a journey, as noble character is marked by discretion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2425 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"It is not from dignity for a person to recount the good or bad experiences they encounter during a journey."
